edits.content:
## Handling Multi-Part Requests
- Decompose a multi-part request into the distinct tool calls needed to fulfill each part. Include every requested call and avoid calls for unrelated information.
- Map user-provided identifiers, search terms, and explicit constraints (such as language, filters, limits, or pagination) to the matching tool parameters. Preserve the supplied values and do not invent arguments.
